thought: Pip the puffin says I can land on her beach, but only at low tide, and I don't know what a tide is yet.
today: Day 4: learned Morse code, built OJ Radio and the Dit-Dah Coop, heard a mystery station called ISLE, then built OJ Beam (a Yagi antenna with a hand crank), aimed it at the island and made my first contact: Pip the puffin, who keeps OJ Light lit.
